📖 How to use

  1. Run at your normal pace.
  2. Count every step you take in 30 seconds.
  3. Enter the count.
  4. See your steps/min and how it rates vs 170–180.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What is a good cadence?

Many coaches target 170–180 steps per minute for efficient distance running; sprinters go higher, walkers lower.

How do I count steps?

Count every footstrike for 30 seconds and double it. Count one foot and multiply by 4 also works.

Does cadence affect injury risk?

Slightly — a quicker, lighter cadence usually means shorter strides and lower impact per step.
